scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/web packages/react packages/vue packages/svelte
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/web packages/react packages/vue packages/svelte
scripts.test:browser: pnpm build && pnpm playground:build && playwright test
scripts.test:visual: pnpm build && pnpm stories:build && PIXEN_VISUAL=1 playwright test visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: pnpm build && pnpm stories:build && PIXEN_VISUAL=1 playwright test visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/*/dist apps/stories/build test-results playwright-report
